# Provider brand marks

Source: LobeHub Icons (@lobehub/icons 6.20.0), MIT.
Commit: 05260484d9f4de68f90cc87a634ae68fa4043efd
Repository: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons

- openai.svg: packages/static-svg/icons/openai.svg
- deepseek-color.svg: packages/static-svg/icons/deepseek-color.svg

Original SVG files and the full upstream LICENSE are included in this directory.
Android VectorDrawable resources preserve the original paths, 24×24 viewports,
and fill rules. The monochrome OpenAI mark uses the current surface foreground;
DeepSeek retains its upstream #4D6BFE fill. Custom API providers use a neutral
server icon rather than a provider brand.
